title: Synthborn: Terrascape Roadmap
subtitle: Release-grouped direction for the first public beta and its feedback cycle

releases.name: Initial Beta Release
releases.summary: Ship the first complete Terrascape experience, including the secure browser console interface.

items.title: Live 3D World
items.description: Stream terrain meshes from the running Hytale world into the browser.

items.title: Mobs & Players
items.description: Show live player markers, player navigation, and detailed mob cards.

items.title: Player Views
items.description: Focus, follow, and first-person camera modes for online players.

items.title: Day / Night Cycle
items.description: Display world time and synchronize the viewer's lighting when enabled.

items.title: Map-Tile Backdrop
items.description: Fill the distance beyond loaded 3D terrain with top-down world tiles.

items.title: Tunable Rendering
items.description: Control mesh distance, water, fog, detail, shading, and load budgets.

items.title: Shareable Access
items.description: Support open maps and secure per-player token-gated links.

items.title: Browser Console Interface
items.description: Provide identity-bound web chat and permission-checked commands with private output history.

releases.name: Community-Driven Updates
releases.summary: Future improvements will follow the needs players and server owners raise during the beta.

items.title: Requested Improvements
items.description: Prioritize meaningful map, camera, console, and usability improvements requested by the community.
